opening.argument: The video explains a routine gift-card purchase and redemption process for Netflix service. It identifies the card as available at retailers, describes its use to pre-pay for a membership or as a gift, and tells viewers where to enter the code. It also explains where to find the code on a standard card. These are practical instructions for using an ordinary retail product. The visible subscribe prompt is audience engagement; it is not presented as a condition for obtaining or using the gift card. Nothing in the cited guidance turns that prompt into a required step in the purchase or redemption process.

citations.quote: This is a Netflix gift card available at many retailers.
use a Netflix gift card to pre-pay for your membership or give as a gift to someone special
Go to netflix.com slash code and enter it.
If you bought a standard card, the code is on the back.
